messages:
aisha.partnerships: Quick sync — EdgeWave (hw partner) asked for a SOC report + pen-test artifact bundle for their GovCloud marketplace listing. They want an embargoed joint PR. Need a staging + upload plan, TTLs for presigned links, and redaction owner. Who can own?

sam.security: I can own the pen evidence ingestion and redaction checklist. Clarify: do they need raw pcap/logs or redacted summaries?

aisha.partnerships: Ideally both: redacted raw artifacts (hash-only references) + full raw to be delivered to Redwood Sec under an NDA. For marketplace we upload redacted bundle to partner S3 presign. Full raw stays in our secure vault.

leo.sis: For SI integrations: we should include an integration-test report (post-deploy smoke tests), a signed manifest with SHA256 hashes, and a minimal runbook for reproducing the test. I can produce the manifest + test outputs.

nora.legal: Embargo notes — joint PR window is sensitive. We need written attestation from EdgeWave and Redwood engineering that no details leak. Legal needs the list of artifact filenames and TTLs before we approve embargo wording.

aisha.partnerships: OK owners: @sam.security = pen + redaction, @leo.sis = manifest + integration-test outputs, @nora.legal = embargo wording & attestation templates. I'll coordinate partner comms and announce the PR timing. Target timeline: prep by 3/28 EOD, staging upload 3/30, presigned links sent 4/1, embargo lift 4/8.

sam.security: Planner notes: for presigns we should NOT put TTL > 7d for redacted bundles; full raw keys never presigned — hand transfer under NDA. Also need a checksum index file: checksums.txt with entries like <sha256>  filename.

sam.security: Presign snippet we use (example):

```
aws s3 presign s3://partner-evidence/edgewave/govcloud/redacted-bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 604800 --region us-gov-west-1
```

sam.security: Use --expires-in 604800 (7 days) only for redacted bundle. For any debug logs we default to 48h.

leo.sis: Example manifest line (signed by CI):

```
{"file":"edgewave-firmware-v1.2.3.bin","sha256":"3f8a...c9b2","size":1423780}
```

leo.sis: We'll GPG-sign the manifest: manifest.json.sig attached to bundle.

evidence-bot: Uploaded: staging/edgewave/govcloud/redacted-bundle.tar.gz (owner=sam.security) — presign ready flag set to false

sam.security: Action items: I will produce the redaction checklist (PII, IP ranges, internal hostnames) and run the scrubbing job. Need an owner for witness access to raw bundle — who at EdgeWave will pick up? Aisha, can you confirm partner contact?

aisha.partnerships: Partner contact = renee.edge@edgewave.com (cc'd via email). Renee will nominate the SI witness for raw artifact pickup. I'll ask for the SI name + ID by EOD today.

nora.legal: Attestation template: short form + signature block. I want dropdown options for embargo length (7d / 14d) and explicit pledge about not publishing vulnerability details. Send me draft by tomorrow morning.

sam.security: One more thing — pen-tests often include vuln IDs that we must treat as sensitive. For the redacted bundle we'll replace identifiers with VULN-XXXX placeholders and include a mapping doc in the secure vault only.

leo.sis: For marketplace listing we also need the SI integration quick-check results (login, feature smoke, latency trace) as a 1-page summary. I'll produce that with traces anonymized.

aisha.partnerships: Sounds good. Summary owners + deadlines: sam.security — redaction checklist + redacted bundle by 3/28, leo.sis — signed manifest + integration summary by 3/28, nora.legal — embargo attestation & wording by 3/27. I'll schedule partner sync 3/26 to confirm.

evidence-bot: Reminder: retention policy enforcement — redacted staging artifacts set to auto-delete in 14 days. Manual override allowed by evidence-bot-admin group.

sam.security: Can we set S3 lifecycle to 30d for audit copies? I want 14d public presign + 30d protected archive with restricted access.

aisha.partnerships: Partner is okay with 30d archive under Redwood read-only access. I'll confirm in the 3/26 sync.

leo.sis: Small ops note: include instructions for reproducing smoke test: docker-compose snippet + env var list. Saves assignees a lot of back-and-forth when marketplace reviewer asks for steps.

aisha.partnerships: Great catch — add that to the integration summary.

nora.legal: Once we have filenames + TTLs, legal will stamp the embargo doc. No PR until attestation signed by both parties.

aisha.partnerships: Final: I'll create the staging bucket path and invite owners. Creating path now: s3://redwood-staging/partners/edgewave/govcloud/ — will post presign when sam flags ready.

sam.security: Ack. I'll drop the redaction checklist link here when done.

aisha.partnerships: Thanks team :raised_hands: — keeping this thread for the execution updates. If anything slips, ping me directly.
